title: BodyRig
description: Head-mounted cameras attached to one full-body model. There is no T_c_h: body joints are already in world space and each camera pose is derived from the head bone every frame.

model.description: Path to the .blend holding the mesh, rig and pose assets.

armature.description: Name of the armature object inside the .blend. Defaults to 'rig'.

hands.description: Hand sides exported to joints_2d.csv, in column order.

head_camera.description: A camera rigidly bolted to the head, as on a real headset. It never turns to follow the hands, so they enter and leave the field of view on their own.

anchor_bone.description: Head bone the camera is rigidly attached to. Defaults to 'ORG-spine.006' (the head bone of a Rigify rig).

rest_position.description: World-space camera position while the body is in its rest pose. Must lie outside the head mesh, in front of the nose tip.

rest_forward.description: World-space direction the camera looks while the body is in its rest pose. The body faces -Y, and hands sit below eye level, so this is normally tilted down: [0, -1, -0.268] is 15 degrees below horizontal. Defaults to that.
